column1: The purpose of this chapter has been to examine the determinants of investment in detail. Looking back on the various models of investment, we can see three themes. First, all types of investment spending are inversely related to the real interest rate. A higher interest rate raises the cost of capital for firms that invest in plant and equipment, raises the cost of borrowing for home-buyers, and raises the cost of holding inventories. Thus, the models of investment developed here justify the investment function we have used throughout this book.
